550:t_2:59.en:
$$宗介$$
(Is he mourning... $$サックス$$'s death...?)

550:t_2:60.en:
$$アル$$
「At the same time, I am concerned that the lack of versatility in me and this machine... and our inefficient maintenance... caused his death.」

550:t_2:61.en:
$$アル$$
「That is what I meant when I asked if it was my fault.」

550:t_2:62.en:
$$宗介$$
(I've heard $$アル$$'s core unit is modeled on the human nervous system, but...)

550:t_2:63.en:
$$宗介$$
(If he feels responsible for $$サックス$$'s death, hasn't he gone beyond merely imitating emotions?)

550:t_2:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$... It isn't your fault. The work was necessary.」

550:t_2:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「And at the end, he said...」

550:t_2:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「He didn't hold a grudge against anyone.」

550:t_2:67.en:
$$アル$$
「That information is highly valuable to me.」

550:t_3:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「No matter where I look, I can't find $$千鳥$$ or anything resembling the device...」

550:t_4:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「The people who stormed $$メリダ島$$ must be stamping their feet in frustration by now.」

550:t_4:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even without using $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$, a teleportation of this scale is effortless for me now.」

550:t_4:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Why did you choose this place as the starting point for repairing space-time?」

550:t_4:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「This place has that kind of significance.」

550:t_4:8.en:
$$レナード$$
「And I thought we probably couldn't make use of its power anywhere else.」

550:t_4:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「It took some work to get it. Without him and the influence he still had within the Empire, it would have been much harder.」

550:t_4:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「Now it's a race against time. Once the $$ＴＡＲＴＡＲＯＳ$$ control program is complete, we'll begin.」

550:t_4:14.en:
$$レナード$$
「They probably will. And once they learn what my plan requires, they will certainly try to stop me.」

550:t_4:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's absurd... As long as I'm here, we can do anything...」

550:t_4:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「They can't understand that. No... It would be more accurate to say they don't want to.」

550:t_4:17.en:
$$レナード$$
「Everything will be ready soon. That will be the beginning of a new world.」

550:t_4:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I will end everything and begin everything...」

550:t_4:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes... That is the mission $$ソフィア$$ entrusted to me...」

550:t_10:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm sorry I worried you, $$メリッサ$$.」

550:t_10:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Yes, yes. I'm busy now, so we'll talk later.」

550:t_10:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Look at her getting all shy... She's adorable.」

550:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... Between us, I eavesdropped on $$マオ$$ and $$宗介$$ in the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s mess hall...」

550:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe $$マオ$$... said she was only playing around with you...」

550:t_10:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'll have to ask $$メリッサ$$ herself about this!」

550:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...When you shot down an enemy while supporting $$マオ$$, she produced 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. I will add them to the team's stock.」

550:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$Ｚチップ$$s don't lie... Those were $$マオ$$'s true feelings.」

550:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Welcome back, $$クルツ$$. Congratulations on your survival and becoming a couple.」

550:t_10:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sorry, $$ＡＧ$$. I don't have time to deal with you now.」

550:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...But I went to the trouble of finding interesting data on the $$ＵＮ$$...」

550:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I suppose it can wait until after this battle...」

550:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We cannot allow anyone to selfishly repair space-time. I wish you all success.」

550:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, as a cheer for you! I'm fired up today too... Business, business!」

551:t_000:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「All units have launched.」

551:t_001:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The enemy interception force is coming!」

551:t_002:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「This really is their headquarters! They're swarming out!」

551:t_002:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「They've even got $$ネオ・ジオン$$ aquatic mobile suits!」

551:t_002:2.en:
$$桂$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ was obsessed with that 'correct world' too.」

551:t_002:3.en:
$$桂$$
「It's very likely $$アマルガム$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ were connected behind the scenes.」

551:t_002:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「But $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ and the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ machines aren't here.」

551:t_002:5.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Knowing him, he'll appear when it will have the greatest effect.」

551:t_002:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That suits me. Then let's quickly finish his lackeys and invite that smug son of a bitch to join us.」

551:t_002:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, proceed to the target point at maximum battle speed!」

551:t_003:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「When this ship reaches this position, we will launch the $$レーバテイン$$.」

551:t_003:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All machines in the strike force, support it.」

551:t_003:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I'm leaving the job of stopping $$千鳥かなめ$$ to you, $$相良$$!」

551:t_003:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm counting on you to support $$宗介$$, $n!」

551:t_003:5.en:
$n
「That's the job $$クルツ$$ entrusted to me!」

551:t_004:0.en:
$$マオ$$
(I'm heading out, $$クルツ$$...! I'm going to disappoint you!)

551:t_005:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, begin attacking! Break through the underwater forces and land on $$メリダ島$$!」

551:t_006:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「We've reached the target point!」

551:t_006:2.en:
$$サックス$$
「Wait, Captain! The $$レーバテイン$$ won't start up!」

551:t_006:4.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Captain! There's a giant AS ahead!」

551:t_007:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The hangar has been hit!」

551:t_008:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The $$ベヘモス$$ is closing on us!」

551:t_008:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$相良$$ and the others are ready! There is no need to dive!」
